zh-TW.title: StockQuant — A股量化回測 + 實時盯盤預警系統｜Pysdn SuperCool
zh-TW.description: StockQuant：生產級量化系統，30+ 回測策略、異步任務佇列、並行加速、四層 TTL 緩存。
zh-TW.hero_sub: 30+ 回測策略 · 實時盯盤 · 異步任務 · 並行加速
zh-TW.intro_p: 生產級量化系統，以 Yahoo Finance 為主數據源，AKShare 為備選；SQLite 本地存儲，FastAPI Web 服務。ECharts 可視化、智能數據預取、虛擬滾動。
zh-TW.f1: 30+ 可回測策略 + 策略庫目錄（分類展示）+ 13+ 組合方法
zh-TW.f2: 異步任務佇列：回測、優化、組合提交後立即返回，Web 端輪詢進度
zh-TW.f3: 並行加速：可配置任務槽位、網格搜索進程/線程池
zh-TW.f4: 結果緩存：相同參數命中緩存秒級返回，支持 LRU 或 Redis
zh-TW.f5: 前端性能優化：智能預取、請求合併、虛擬滾動、Web Worker、四層 TTL 緩存
zh-TW.strategies_html:
• 技術指標：MACD、KDJ、RSI、布林帶、均線系統
  • 趨勢跟蹤：海龜交易、通道突破、動量策略
  • 均值回歸：統計套利、配對交易
  • 機器學習：LSTM 預測、XGBoost 分類
  • 組合方法：等權、市值加權、風險平價、最大夏普
zh-TW.perf_html:
指標優化前優化後改善
首屏加載2.5s1.2s↓ 52%
API 延遲180ms95ms↓ 47%
緩存命中率25%65%↑ 160%
長列表渲染2500ms80ms↓ 97%
zh-TW.quickstart_html:
git clone https://github.com/iiooiioo888/stock-quant.git
cd stock-quant
pip install -e .
# 啟動服務
python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload
# 或 Docker
docker compose up -d
zh-TW.api_html:
• GET /api/health — 健康檢查
  • POST /api/backtest — 提交回測任務
  • GET /api/tasks/{id} — 任務進度
  • GET /api/strategies — 策略列表
  • GET /api/market/{symbol} — 行情查詢

en.title: StockQuant — A-Share Quantitative Backtesting + Real-Time Monitoring｜Pysdn SuperCool
en.description: StockQuant: Production-grade quant system with 30+ backtest strategies, async task queue, parallel acceleration, 4-layer TTL cache.
en.hero_sub: 30+ Backtest Strategies · Real-Time Monitoring · Async Tasks · Parallel Acceleration
en.intro_p: Production-grade quantitative system using Yahoo Finance as primary data source, AKShare as fallback; SQLite local storage, FastAPI web service. ECharts visualization, smart prefetch, virtual scrolling.
en.f1: 30+ backtestable strategies + strategy library catalog + 13+ portfolio methods
en.f2: Async task queue: backtest, optimize, portfolio submit-and-poll progress
en.f3: Parallel acceleration: configurable task slots, grid search process/thread pools
en.f4: Result cache: same params hit cache in seconds, LRU or Redis support
en.f5: Frontend optimization: smart prefetch, request batching, virtual scroll, Web Worker, 4-layer TTL cache
en.strategies_html:
• Technical Indicators: MACD, KDJ, RSI, Bollinger Bands, MA systems
  • Trend Following: Turtle trading, channel breakout, momentum
  • Mean Reversion: Statistical arbitrage, pairs trading
  • Machine Learning: LSTM prediction, XGBoost classification
  • Portfolio Methods: Equal weight, market cap, risk parity, max Sharpe
en.quickstart_html:
git clone https://github.com/iiooiioo888/stock-quant.git
cd stock-quant
pip install -e .
python -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload
en.api_html:
• GET /api/health — Health check
  • POST /api/backtest — Submit backtest task
  • GET /api/tasks/{id} — Task progress
  • GET /api/strategies — Strategy list
